hints.title: Character Consumption Rates
hints.text: Every instance of target requires a specific number of occurrences of each letter.

hints.title: Available Letter Counts
hints.text: Count the available letters in s and required letters in target using frequency tallies.

hints.title: Bottleneck Character Bound
hints.text: The maximum copies formed is the minimum of s_count[ch] // target_count[ch] over all letters in target.

hints.title: Bottleneck Quotient Calculation Implementation

complexity.notes: Alphabet size is bounded by 26 lowercase English letters.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating copies by character deletion is slower than direct arithmetic division.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Frequency tables store counts for at most 26 letters.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate computes the bottleneck letter quota in O(1) auxiliary space.
